Name: Candle Torch Replacer
Author: herbivoor
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3][center][/center][center]Please let me know if you run into any problems.

﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

Just a teeny tiny mod that changes the vanilla torch sprite to a candle wrapped in vines

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sD7nDxE.png[/img]﻿

﻿﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

[u]Requirements[/u]
﻿
Only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/center][center]
﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

[u]Installation[/u]

You can find a complete basics guide to modding [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url]﻿. For the vast majority of mods (including all of mine), simply follow that guide and then extract the .rar or .zip file provided by the modder into your Mods folder.
